title: PPG-MS1 — Block-by-Block Speed/Feed Runtime (3-layer: post-bake / parametric F[#101] / in-cycle FOCAS+OPC-UA)
description: Replaces single-feed-per-operation posts with block-by-block recalculation that responds to changing engagement, depth-of-cut, chip thickness, and chatter risk. Three runtime layers: L1 (post-bake) emits per-block S/F into the program; L2 (shop-floor parametric) emits F[#101] macro variables an operator can scale on the controller; L3 (in-cycle) writes feed override via FOCAS (Fanuc) or OPC-UA (Hurco/Okuma/Heidenhain). Layer choice depends on controller capability and AGI tier (omega-thresholds.json from PPG-MS8).
rationale: JM Die programs lose 8-22% cycle time to constant feed rates that pessimize for the worst block in an operation (typically corner engagement). The audit showed PostProcessorFeedOptimizerEngine + ChatterStabilityLobeEngine + KienzleForceModel can already compute per-block targets, but no post wires them block-level — only operation-level. This milestone closes that wiring gap.

SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine (2,851 LOC) — central physics hub, AtomicValue outputs
AutoSpeedFeedEngine + UltimateSpeedFeedEngine + MachineAwareSpeedFeedEngine + LatheSpeedFeedCalculatorFacadeEngine + AutoSpeedFeedCalculatorEngine — domain-specific facades
PostProcessorFeedOptimizerEngine — physics-aware feed bake (chatter + tool life), already wired into MasterPostProcessorEngine.ts:33+426

MasterPostProcessorEngine + MasterPostProcessorUnifiedAGIEngine (E0322) + PostProcessorAGIMasterRegistryEngine + MasterPostFineTuningEngine (E0321) + PostProcessorUnificationEngine (E0383) — emit-side integrators
KienzleForceModelEngine — per-block force given h, b, kc1.1, mc
InstantaneousEngagementEngine + EngagementDynamicsEngine (E0140) + EngagementOptimizerAdapter (E0141) — per-block radial/axial engagement
ChipThinningCompensationEngine (E0103) — gamma correction for ball-nose / round inserts
SFCInferenceGateWireEngine + SFCOutcomeCaptureWireEngine — SFC bridge engines (PSAU-PPG-SFC outputs)
MTConnect adapter (read-only) and OPC-UA adapter (write+read) — machine_live dispatcher (already wired)
CSSChipLoadInvariantCoordinatorEngine (E0125) — G96 CSS feed-rate continuity for lathe (LATHE-PROD-READY-MS0 U-LPR05)
LatheSpeedFeedCalculatorFacadeEngine — lathe-specific S/F facade (already in MS1 wiring)
OkumaB250LatheMasterPostEngine (E0355) + LatheMasterPostRouter (E0269) — lathe master post emit targets

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Hurco V11 roughing a D2 corner pocket. Engagement varies from 40% (open straight) to 95% (corner radius).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms1: Post emits one F=320 mm/min for the entire roughing op, sized to survive the 95% corner. Open passes run 2.4× too slow. 18% cycle-time waste.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms1: L1: post bakes F=560 (open) → F=320 (corner) → F=560 transitions block-by-block. L2: F=#101*[engagement_scale_table] for shop tweak. L3: WinMax UltiMotion confirms via OPC-UA write of feed override based on live spindle load.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Per-block math reaches the program. iMachining-class results without the iMachining license.

units.title: Cycle-time regression harness
units.scope: src/__tests__/BlockByBlockFeed.regression.test.ts — 50 golden D2/M2/A2 toolpaths; assert ≥10% cycle-time win without violating chatter/force ceilings

units.title: Lathe G96 CSS block-by-block path (E0125 wired through L1+L2)
units.scope: Wire CSSChipLoadInvariantCoordinatorEngine (E0125) into BlockByBlockFeedEngine for lathe ops; emit per-block S (m/min) → spindle RPM under G96 with S-clamp at G50; L2 macro emits #101*scale_table for diameter-aware override; round-trip test on Okuma B250 OD turning + boring + grooving (≥3 ISO groups: P=4140, M=304SS, K=cast iron).

units.title: WEDM block-by-block energy schedule (skim pass override at L1)
units.scope: Wire EDMMultiPassStrategyEngine into BlockByBlockFeedEngine for WEDM dialects (Mitsubishi M800, Sodick MotionLink, AgieCharmilles, Makino, Fanuc 31i WEDM); per-block (E, TON, TOFF, IP) instead of per-pass; sidecar carries the per-pass schedule.

completion_criteria: Per-block F[] reaches the program for every operation in the 13 master posts
L1/L2 always available; L3 available when controller supports FOCAS or OPC-UA write
≥10% cycle-time reduction on the 50-program JM Die regression corpus, zero violations of chatter/force/torque ceilings
Tier-aware: L3 only enables at omega tier ≥ proven_out (from PPG-MS8)
Lathe G96 CSS path: per-block spindle RPM consistent with cutting-speed target across diameter sweep on Okuma B250 OD turn corpus (≥10 reference programs)
WEDM per-block energy schedule: 5 dialects emit pass-aware E/TON/TOFF without operator hand-edits
